8B. The driver of a motor vehicle shall not enter into or drive or use such motor vehicle on an expressway unless such
motor vehicle is fitted with individual safety seat belts as specified in regulation 8E which function properly, to be worn
by the driver, every passenger and individual occupying a seat and travelling therein.
8c. An owner of a motor vehicle shall not enter into or cause to be entered into such motor vehicle an expressway
unless such motor vehicle is fitted with individual safety seat belts as specified in regulation 8E which function properly,
to be worn by the driver, every passenger and individual occupying a seat and travelling therein.
